name: Innosys Inc.

about:
InnoSys Inc. was founded in 2000 and operates from a facility near downtown Salt Lake City, Utah. The company began as a developer of advanced electronic devices and subsystems, leveraging expertise in microelectronics and materials science.

The company provides integrated manufacturing services spanning micro-fabrication, MEMS, micro-machining, 3D ceramic printing, electronic packaging, and extensive test and evaluation. Its Salt Lake City site includes a Class 1000 cleanroom, brazing chambers, machining equipment, and assembly lines, allowing production from starting materials to finished packages.

InnoSys serves aerospace, vacuum electronics, solid-state lighting, and microelectronics sectors. Its solid-state vacuum devices (SSVDs) have been presented at the IEEE Aerospace Conference and International Vacuum Electronics Conference, while its OLED power supply work has been featured in Department of Energy workshops and OLED stakeholder meetings.

The firm states its mission is to innovate in electronic device, circuit, and subsystem design to achieve higher performance, functionality, and reliability with reduced size, weight, and cost, targeting applications such as high data bandwidth, power efficiency, and harsh-environment operation.
